chunks: And in the narration of Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Ziyād, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, he said: ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
No man's hair has ever become abundant except that his desire became less.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the preceding Imam in the sanad
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about abundant hair and diminished desire?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a concise statement from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describing a correlation between abundant body hair and reduced sexual desire in a man. It is presented as a transmitted observation in the hadith corpus rather than as a legal ruling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4649 - In the narration of Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), it is reported that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "
No man has ever had an abundance of hair without his desire becoming less."
